snippet.title: Super Monkey Ball 2: Bad-Boon Strikes Back v4.0 - Beginner
snippet.description:
Playthrough of KartingKoopa's Super Monkey Ball 2 mod, "Bad-Boon Strikes Back v4.0". This video completes 20 stages (10 normal, 10 extra) found in the Beginner and Beginner Extra difficulties.

Sorry for not uploading Monkey Ball videos in a while again! I'm trying to upload and record more videos I've had in mind for a while, but situations out of my control have been impacting uploads as of late.

Download the pack here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rxVdh5MRqWo9S8vSYiNrzRn3g-n3nRyY/view?usp=sharing

Played on Dolphin Emulator using a DS4 controller.
I hope everyone enjoys and feel free to like, comment, and subscribe!
